title: Mitochonic acid 5 rescues cardiomyocytes from doxorubicin-induced toxicity via repressing the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB/NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis.
authors: Zha, Wenliang; Zhao, Qian; Xiao, Ye; Gan, Yuanyuan; Wei, Junjun; Yu, Mengqi; Xu, Yanmei; Xu, Qiongyao; Wu, Shi; Yu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究MA5通过TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB/NLRP3通路缓解阿霉素心肌毒性，虽用分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: Doxorubicin (DOX) is an effective anti-tumor drug, but the cardiotoxicity severely limits its clinical use. Interestingly, a hypothesis has emerged suggesting an association between DOX-induced cardiotoxicity and mitochondrial disorders and oxidative stress. The mitochonic acid 5 (MA5) shows promise in alleviating mitochondrial dysfunction by promoting mitochondrial ATP synthesis and reducing reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, though its potential in ameliorating DOX-induced cardiotoxicity remains elusive. METHODS: Network pharmacology approach, molecular docking techniques, and molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) were used to reveal the specific drug targets and pharmaceutical mechanisms involved in the treatment of DOX-induced cardiotoxicity using MA5. For experimental verification, cardiomyocytes (H9c2) and mice were exposed to DOX in the presence or absence of MA5. Our investigation involved the assessment of echocardiographic parameters, cardiac enzymes, inflammatory factors, mitochondrial function, myocardial structure, and cardiomyocyte pyroptosis. RESULTS: Among the 100 core targets identified in network pharmacology, MA5 was pharmacologically active against DOX-induced cardiotoxicity via pathways implicated in cancer, prostate cancer, lipids and atherosclerosis. Molecular docking analysis confirmed that MA5 docked well with TNF-alpha, interleukin-6 (IL-6), and caspase-3. Furthermore, MA5 exhibited a stronger affinity toward TNF-alpha than IL-6 and caspase-3. Subsequent MDS revealed the stability of binding between MA5 and TNF-alpha. The DOX-challenged mice also displayed abnormal myocardial enzymogram, disrupted systolic and diastolic function, and elevated inflammation and cardiomyocyte pyroptosis, which could be mitigated by the administration of MA5. Similarly, H9c2 cells exposed to DOX showed increased intracellular ROS production and impaired mitochondrial function, which were relieved by MA5 treatment. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that MA5 attenuates DOX-induced cardiac anomalies through the TNF-alpha-mediated regulation of inflammation and pyroptosis. These insights offer a potential therapeutic strategy for managing DOX-induced cardiac complications, thereby improving the safety and efficacy of cancer treatments.
abstract_zh: 目的：多柔比星（DOX）是一种有效的抗肿瘤药物，但其心脏毒性严重限制了其临床应用。有趣的是，已有假说提出DOX诱导的心脏毒性与线粒体障碍和氧化应激之间存在关联。线粒体酸5（MA5）通过促进线粒体ATP合成和减少活性氧（ROS）积累，显示出缓解线粒体功能障碍的潜力，但其在改善DOX诱导的心脏毒性方面的作用仍不明确。方法：采用网络药理学方法、分子对接技术和分子动力学模拟（MDS）来揭示MA5治疗DOX诱导心脏毒性的具体药物靶点和药理机制。为进行实验验证，将心肌细胞（H9c2）和小鼠在有无MA5的情况下暴露于DOX。我们的研究涉及评估超声心动图参数、心肌酶、炎症因子、线粒体功能、心肌结构和心肌细胞焦亡。结果：在网络药理学识别的100个核心靶点中，MA5通过涉及癌症、前列腺癌、脂质和动脉粥样硬化的通路对DOX诱导的心脏毒性具有药理活性。分子对接分析证实，MA5与肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）、白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和半胱天冬酶-3（caspase-3）对接良好。此外，MA5对TNF-alpha的亲和力强于IL-6和caspase-3。随后的MDS揭示了MA5与TNF-alpha之间结合的稳定性。受到DOX攻击的小鼠还表现出心肌酶谱异常、收缩和舒张功能紊乱，以及炎症和心肌细胞焦亡升高，这些均可通过MA5给药得到缓解。类似地，暴露于DOX的H9c2细胞显示细胞内ROS产生增加和线粒体功能受损，而MA5处理可缓解这些情况。结论：我们的研究结果表明，MA5通过TNF-alpha介导的炎症和焦亡调节来减轻DOX诱导的心脏异常。这些见解为管理DOX诱导的心脏并发症提供了一种潜在的治疗策略，从而提高了癌症治疗的安全性和有效性。
